conclusion: Stored Goop step_context is unused by the released Goop parser/model input contract because the exact official metadata lacks context_mean. This justification is independent of NaN or constancy observations. Preserve auxiliary bytes and hashes, and explicitly declare their omission under this source contract.

evidence.fact: Only context_mean in metadata selects a feature description containing step_context; absent context_mean selects position only, even if the serialized record stores an auxiliary.
Training and rollout propagate step_context only if the parser returned it; features.get yields None otherwise. Context normalization is created only if metadata supplies context_mean.
Context is normalized and attached to GraphsTuple.globals only when global_context is not None.

not_claimed: No located source prose labels the stored Goop NaN values a placeholder.
This review does not certify full auxiliary values/hash census, real numerical admission, backend parity, compute fit or scientific results.
rollout_scope_note: The released TensorFlow prepare_rollout_inputs removes the final frame from its position input and rollout uses sequence_length minus six (394 predictions for Goop). The proposed current study explicitly uses all 401 stored frames: six observed plus395 forecasts. Describe this as the declared complete stored-trajectory horizon, not exact reproduction of the released TF evaluation horizon.
